### Notes:
Speaker: Laura “Here’s an early look at the new Seamless Home Screen experience coming to 2026 LG TVs, with plans to push this enhancement back to older models as well. This redesign gives us a major opportunity to elevate the home screen as a premium entry point for brand storytelling. As part of this upgrade, we’re exploring a new Seamless Home Screen Ad Unit that would run alongside the Carousel. This format is built to deliver a truly immersive moment — think full-screen banner or video creative that auto-expands on hover, paired with buttery-smooth transitions that feel high-end and intentional. It’s designed to blend seamlessly into user behavior while unlocking more impactful real estate for partners. From a performance standpoint, this unit positions LG to compete directly with what other OEMs are already offering — but with the benefit of our cleaner UX and deeper household-level data. It’s a chance to drive higher engagement, richer storytelling, and incremental visibility during peak discovery moments. Before we finalize development and prioritization, we’d love your perspective. Is this a unit you’d want to test or incorporate into your FY26 planning? Your feedback will directly shape how quickly we bring this to market — and we’d be excited to build this with you.”
